requirement: Operators shall be able to list the project's currently running deployment stages in the current AWS account and region through a terminal workflow using configured AWS CLI credentials.
Operators shall be able to apply connector definitions to a specified cluster and service and restart the affected connectors to put the configuration into operation.

The system shall route service events matching configured criteria through AWS EventBridge to an SNS topic authorized to receive them and distribute notifications to subscribed targets. Operators with subscription-management access shall be able to add or remove subscribers manually without requiring redeployment.

The repository's CI/CD workflows shall use GitHub Actions. For a specified branch, the system shall aggregate deployment-workflow runs across all returned result pages and report successful and failed run counts, treating every conclusion other than success as failed and calculating successful runs as the total minus failed runs.

For a specified base branch, the system shall report average pull-request merge time using closed pull requests with both creation and merge timestamps. It shall aggregate all returned result pages, calculate each merge duration in whole hours, and report their arithmetic mean, returning zero when no pull requests qualify.
